21 trait IntEncodersImplicits extends Serializable {
22 
23   // RuleResultWithProcessor's are lost in serialization by design, they only make sense in a given run
24 
25   /**
26    * Converts the DQ results to and from Int and RuleResult's.  Probability is processed by the value / PassedInt
27    */
28   implicit val ruleResultToInt: Injection[RuleResult, Int] = Injection(
29     {
30       case r: RuleResult => Serializing.ruleResultToInt(r)
31     },
32     {
33       case SoftFailedInt => SoftFailed
34       case DisabledRuleInt => DisabledRule
35       case IgnoredRuleInt => IgnoredRule
36       case DefaultRuleInt => DefaultRule
37       case FailedInt => Failed
38       case PassedInt => Passed
39       case a: Int => Probability(a.toDouble / PassedInt)
40     })
41 
42 }
43

163 object MapUtils {
164   def toScalaMap(map: MapData, keyType: DataType, valueType: DataType): Map[Any, Any] = {
165     val keys = map.keyArray.toObjectArray(keyType)
166     val values = map.valueArray.toObjectArray(valueType)
167     keys.zip(values).toMap
168   }
169 
170   /**
171    * Assuming MapData entries are stable, as they are array backed, over a dataset.  When the position of 'what' is not in the cachedPositions a full search is performed with the new location being returned in addition.
172    *
173    * @param mapData the source mapdata to search through.
174    * @param cachedPositions already known positions to check for what
175    * @param what compared against the keyArray to obtain the position
176    * @param getValue obtain the value from the mapData, with any necessary conversions, against the index parameter
177    * @tparam T
178    * @return (result from getValue or null when not found, either cachedPositions or cachedPositions and a newly found position)
179    */
180   def getMapEntry[T <: AnyRef](mapData: MapData, cachedPositions: Seq[Int], what: Any)(getValue: Int => T): (T, Seq[Int]) = {
181     val keys = mapData.keyArray()
182     val n = keys.numElements()
183     val acc = (idx: Int) => keys.getLong(idx)
184 
185     def search() = {
186       var i = 0
187       var found = false
188       while (i < n && !found) {
189         if (acc(i) == what) {
190           found = true
191         } else {
192           i += 1
193         }
194       }
195       if (!found)
196         -1
197       else
198         i
199     }
200 
201     def withCached() =
202       cachedPositions.find { i =>
203         if (i < n)
204           acc(i) == what
205         else
206           false
207       }
208 
209     withCached().map(i => (getValue(i), cachedPositions))
210       .getOrElse {
211         val r = search()
212         if (r == -1)
213           (null.asInstanceOf[T], cachedPositions)
214         else
215           (getValue(r), cachedPositions :+ r)
216       }
217   }
218 
219 }
